question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rich**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has the **article ****a** before the blank which means a word with a **consonant **sound can fit the sentence.
 
• The word '**r**' is a consonant sound and **rich** is the appropriate adjective &
